svg.title: Conversation Search: recall what compaction dropped
svg.desc: StepPersistence saves the full message history to a step store at every step. When compaction later drops messages from the live context, the model can call search_conversation_history. ConversationSearch keeps only runs with the calling run's conversation_id, replays their complete snapshots from the store to recover the original messages, ranks them with BM25, and returns the best excerpts with the messages around them.
